risk_note: RV2 (balance decision, app.module and worker wiring). BR-ID-27: a 60 s identity timer scans due cooling requests in (cooling_until, id) keyset batches, one transaction per request: users row FOR NO KEY UPDATE, re-read the request; available < 0 -> transition() to cancelled (negative_balance); a non-terminal withdrawal (WithdrawalNonTerminalReader, honest false until B2-05, TODO) -> defer with a once-a-day-per-process warning; otherwise users.status = deleting and transition() to processing in the same transaction. 15 working-day overdue warning (risk working-day function, calendar read once per (app_id, year)). SMS login of a deleting account answers 10007 stage=processing without creating, signing or logging; round 2 locks the users row and re-reads the status in the session transaction (money r1 S1, race with the expiry task). Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).

reviews.note: r1 fail S1 (expiry task vs SMS login race), fixed in implementation round 2; r2 pass, no findings
